title: Loyalty Pass v1.0 Release
notes: Official Version 1.0 Release: Staged Rollout Control - Updates release first to Owner Terminal for testing, and customers update after Owner taps Broadcast.
features: 2-Stage Release Architecture: Updates appear first in Owner App for store testing
Customer passes only prompt for updates after the Store Owner taps 'Broadcast to Customers'
Live Customer Broadcast Status indicator in Owner Settings
Seamless Realtime cloud notification delivery upon owner broadcast
